purpose: One fixed postfit inference utility screen, not candidate fitting or independent confirmation
mechanism: R93 v002 / R94 qualified float64 CPU implementation

data.selected_split: Existing R72 evaluation partition; no new cohort, sampling or official valid/test.

controls.native: Same frozen native head cast from FP32 checkpoint to FP64, direct epsilon Born attention and original signed readout
controls.simplex: beta proportional alpha0*exp((u-f0)/M), M=max valid absolute centered utility, M=1 if zero; padding excluded before exp. Same utility access, not compute matched
controls.pinched: R94 query-block pinching with full A normalization; changes magnitude and offblock
controls.permuted: Exact R93 input-ID utility permutation, construction path only; recipient original utilities retained in final readout

primary: Positive39 Macro-F1 full-minus-native, all39 included and absent classes zero. CE secondary.
decision: DISCOVERY_POINT_POSITIVE_NOT_CONFIRMATORY iff full Macro delta>0 and CE delta<=0; otherwise NO_POSITIVE_FIXED_CHECKPOINT_SCREEN. Always retain all five outcomes and signed deltas. No formal promotion or new evidence tier from this screen.
scientific_stop: Nonfinite, input identity failure, zero-update tolerance failure or own-gain bound failure stops same attempt. No clipping, tolerance adjustment, automatic retry or coefficient search.
limitations: Repeated discovery cohort; no independent confirmation or population inference
Native final4 checkpoint only; postfit update mismatch does not test jointly trained candidate
FP64 batch4 baseline is deliberately prospective for all conditions; no claim of historical FP32 bitwise equivalence, old strict gates unchanged
Missing evaluation classes17/23/24/32/36/37; original full-data utility not remeasured
No unique quantum attribution from pinching/permutation, no cost-parity or novelty proof
private_outputs: Only child command/stdout/stderr; no per-example predictions, arrays, dataset or new weights retained
